items.title: Diamond Demons
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Diamonds. Symbol of the pure. The powerful. The wealthy. It's only appropriate that it belongs to the demons! Diamond demons!

- 12 roleplay skins!
- Cute and casual attire inspired by diamonds!

items.title: The Lazy Mansion
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: Your own millionaire mansion awaits!

items.title: Survival Sweet Castle
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: A new sweet castle just for you! Even sweeter, there's lucky blocks full of sweet surprises or bitter ends! Take a chance and find out how sweet your lucky story begins!

items.title: Skyblock Dream World
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description: A skyblock world of your dreams with a twist of lucky blocks!

items.title: Millionaire Tropical Island
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Millionaire Tropical Island is the premium survival destination! 

Live in a giant modern mansion, enjoy life on the beach, and climb through the mountaintops!

items.title: Neon Party
items.creator: BBB Studios
items.description: It's neon party time! Grab your glowsticks and hit the dance floor with your friends as one of these bright and fun neon skins!

items.title: Fashion Trends
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Trying to flex big time this summer? Try the hottest fashion and trends of this year and stand out among your friends! Show off what you're wearing with our newest collection and express your clothing style!
+ 2 FREE skins!
+ 10 additional skins to add to your collection!
By ShapeStudio

items.title: ROLEPLAY: Venice
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
It's time to put on your role-playing outfits and explore the city of Venice! Visit the grand cathedral, induct yourself into the large school; or just race your friends around the city!

+ A variety of furniture and vehicle models
+ Lots of locations to visit
+ 16 roleplay skins
+ 1 FREE skin

items.title: Modern Diamond Mansion
items.creator: Odyssey Builds
items.description:
Live the rich life in this large modern mansion; built on a private island. Ride jet-skis around the coast, or look down on the manor from your own private helicopter!

+ Includes furniture models
+ Click on a car with a diamond to turn it into a diamond car!
+ 4 millionaire teen skins
+ 1 FREE skin

items.title: Free Falling: Infinite Dropper
items.creator: RareLoot
items.description:
3..2..1 go! Jump right on into the action! Drop through 15 beautifully themed levels in two exciting game modes: Normal and Infinite! Test your skills with increasing levels of difficulty! Play by yourself or challenge your friends to see who is the fastest!

- Includes custom cosmetics
- 15 themed maps
- Single and Multiplayer 
- By RareLoot

items.title: Craftable: Halloween
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Get your spook on and craft your very own creepy house in Craftable: Halloween! OooOooooOoo!

- Includes 10 craftable houses (including zombie, creepy carnival, spooky cabin, haunted house, jack o'lantern, and more!)
- Custom ghost mob... OooOo scary!
- Easy to use Craftidex recipe browser 
- Nudge, rotate and undo support
- 10 skins included
- By 57Digital

items.title: Mindcraft Animals
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Test your knowledge of animals with Mindcraft! Are you as wise as an owl? Discover the wildest pro among your friends!

Featuring:
+ 90 different questions on the animal kingdom to solve!
+ Dioramas inspired by the animal kingdom!
+ Includes 4 cool animal skins

items.title: Royal Slimes
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These slimes now have crowns and have all started their own kingdoms! Queens, kings, and rulers from across the world, watch out for these new empires!

- 8 royal skins!
- With so many colors to pick from, you can find the right slime that suits you!

items.title: Baby Pets
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Do you love animals and pets? Enjoy this cute world filled with baby pets! Look how cute and adorable they are!

+ 11 animal additions!

items.title: Advanced Village
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Start your survival adventure, explore the custom world and build a new life in cozy village! 

+Survival spawn
+Single and multiplayer friendly

items.title: Ninja Masters
items.creator: Sapphire Studios
items.description: Ready to become a ninja master? Start your ninja training here as a white belt and work your way up. Surely you can join the rank of master with lots of hard work!

items.title: Hallowen Secret Base
items.creator: Gearblocks
items.description: Are you afraid of ghosts? No?? Than this is the perfect map for you! On this haunted secret base you will need courage to explore all the rooms!

items.title: 1000 Blocks
items.creator: The World Foundry
items.description:
Collect all 1000 blocks by hunting for geode deposits, or harvesting pieces from friendly Cyootoons, enemy Cyajztics, and natural spawning outcrops. Each block is unique! One thousand new blocks, and a set of exciting new skins. Complete the monument, or build with these amazing new textures. Lucky you!

Play multiplayer, single player, survival, or in creative mode.

items.title: Modern Fashion
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Stay up-to-date with the latest fashion trends with this modern skin pack! This pack has an outfit for everyone.

- Fashionable
- 8 skins
- Made by: Artifact Studios

items.title: Day Gamerz Night Playerz
items.creator: G2Crafted
items.description:
Day Gamerz - Hangs out all day with their crew playing video games and chowing on some snacks.
Night Playerz - Spends their nights at the club, looking their best and getting crazy.
Which one are you? Try these skins on to find out if you're a gamer, a player, or a little bit of both.

- 12 skins
- 2 free
- Created by G2Crafted

items.title: Halloween Party
items.creator: Rainbow Theory
items.description:
The Halloween costume party is underway! It's time to dress up as your favorite character and be the life of the party! From skeletons to pumpkins, it's time to show off your spooky side!

- 8 Spooky Skins!
- By Rainbow Theory Studios

items.title: Millionaire Island
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Welcome to Millionaire Island, a luxurious getaway only available in the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Escape the hustle of the city and relax in the opulent grandeur available to only an exclusive few. Explore the island at your own pace and settle in to make it a home away from home!

items.title: Haunted Fashion
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description:
Not quite sure what to wear to your Halloween party? Do you need something scary to get you in the Halloween spirit? Then this collection of 12 outfits with a spooky twist will definitely give your friends a fright!
-1 Free

items.title: Halloween Party Teens
items.creator: Pixelationz Studios
items.description:
Halloween is coming! Now's the time to get into the spirit with these spooky outfits. From pumpkin masks to skeleton suits, this pack has everything you'll need! Or perhaps, you would want something a little less scary, like one of the cute fall-colored outfits. Either way, you'll surely be ready for the festivities to begin!
-1 Free
